```{r}
####################################################################################################
# BLOCK A — NON-AGGREGATED ROBUSTNESS MODELS MATCHING THE PRIMARY MODEL DEFINITIONS
#
# PURPOSE
# -------
# Refit the primary trophic-index relationships at the native observation level rather than after
# species-level averaging, while keeping the biological response definitions and model structure
# aligned with the primary species-level models.
#
# PRIMARY ALIGNMENT
# -----------------
# TPF:
#   - same response definition as primary model:
#       transporter abundance / total abundance
#   - same beta(logit) family
#   - same covariate logic:
#       trophic index + protein recovery
#   - same taxonomic random effect:
#       (1 | Phylum)
#   - additional repeated-measures random effect:
#       (1 | Species_ID)
#
# Bray-Curtis:
#   - same response definition as primary model:
#       transporter-only KEGG intensity profiles
#   - same consecutive-date logic as primary model:
#       Bray-Curtis is computed only between adjacent dates in the filtered retained date sequence
#       for each species, NOT strict calendar-day adjacency
#   - same Gaussian-on-logit-scale family
#   - same covariate logic:
#       trophic index + mean paired protein recovery
#   - same taxonomic random effect:
#       (1 | Phylum)
#   - additional repeated-measures random effect:
#       (1 | Species_ID)
#
####################################################################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(vegan)
  library(glmmTMB)
  library(performance)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(readr)
  library(gt)
  library(DHARMa)
  library(broom.mixed)
})

set.seed(1)

############################################################
# 1) SETTINGS
############################################################

out_dir <- "BlockA_PrimaryAligned_NonAggregated"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

dpi_out <- 300
eps <- 1e-6

# Keep this consistent with the filtered retained workflow
min_valid_dates_per_species <- 5

trophic_cols <- c(
  "Oligotroph"   = "#99C3E6",
  "Intermediate" = "#ECEAE9",
  "Copiotroph"   = "#B25009"
)

############################################################
# 2) BASIC CHECKS
############################################################

stopifnot(
  exists("protein_final"),
  exists("retained_species"),
  exists("retained_species_dates"),
  exists("species_taxonomy")
)

required_protein_cols <- c(
  "Species_ID", "Protein_ID", "Date", "Group_For_Plots",
  "TrophicIndex", "Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm",
  "KEGG_Subcategory", "KEGG_ID"
)

required_species_cols <- c("Species_ID", "Group_For_Plots")
required_species_date_cols <- c("Species_ID", "Date", "Group_For_Plots")
required_tax_cols <- c("Species_ID", "Phylum", "Class")

stopifnot(all(required_protein_cols %in% names(protein_final)))
stopifnot(all(required_species_cols %in% names(retained_species)))
stopifnot(all(required_species_date_cols %in% names(retained_species_dates)))
stopifnot(all(required_tax_cols %in% names(species_taxonomy)))

protein_final <- protein_final %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

retained_species_dates <- retained_species_dates %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

species_taxonomy_use <- species_taxonomy %>%
  dplyr::select(Species_ID, Phylum, Class) %>%
  distinct()

############################################################
# 3) HELPERS
############################################################

theme_nat <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1, colour = "black"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6)
    )
}

recode_plot_group <- function(x) {
  out <- dplyr::case_when(
    x == "Oligo_like"   ~ "Oligotroph",
    x == "Copio_like"   ~ "Copiotroph",
    x == "Intermediate" ~ "Intermediate",
    TRUE                ~ NA_character_
  )
  factor(out, levels = c("Oligotroph", "Intermediate", "Copiotroph"))
}

logit_bounded <- function(x, eps = 1e-6) {
  x2 <- pmin(pmax(x, eps), 1 - eps)
  qlogis(x2)
}

inv_logit <- function(x) {
  plogis(x)
}

scale_z <- function(x) {
  s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(s) || s == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  as.numeric(scale(x))
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, digits = digits, format = "fg", flag = "#"))
}

fmt_p <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x), "NA",
    ifelse(x < 0.001, "<0.001", formatC(x, digits = 3, format = "fg", flag = "#"))
  )
}

extract_fixed_effect <- function(model, term_name = "TrophicIndex_z") {
  sm <- summary(model)$coefficients$cond
  if (!term_name %in% rownames(sm)) {
    return(tibble(
      estimate = NA_real_,
      std_error = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  tibble(
    estimate  = unname(sm[term_name, "Estimate"]),
    std_error = unname(sm[term_name, "Std. Error"]),
    p_value   = unname(sm[term_name, "Pr(>|z|)"])
  )
}

safe_numeric <- function(x) {
  out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (length(out) == 0 || all(is.na(out))) NA_real_ else out[1]
}

############################################################
# 4) SHARED RETAINED UNIVERSE
############################################################

species_traits <- protein_final %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, TrophicIndex, Group_For_Plots)

analysis_species_dates <- retained_species_dates %>%
  semi_join(retained_species, by = c("Species_ID", "Group_For_Plots")) %>%
  left_join(species_traits, by = c("Species_ID", "Group_For_Plots")) %>%
  left_join(species_taxonomy_use, by = "Species_ID") %>%
  mutate(TrophicGroupPlot = recode_plot_group(Group_For_Plots)) %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, Date, Group_For_Plots, TrophicIndex, TrophicGroupPlot, Phylum, Class) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(TrophicIndex),
    !is.na(TrophicGroupPlot),
    !is.na(Phylum),
    !is.na(Class)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Species_ID, Date)

prot_counts <- protein_final %>%
  semi_join(
    analysis_species_dates %>% dplyr::select(Species_ID, Date),
    by = c("Species_ID", "Date")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species_ID, Date) %>%
  summarise(
    N_prot_detected = n_distinct(Protein_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

analysis_species_dates <- analysis_species_dates %>%
  left_join(prot_counts, by = c("Species_ID", "Date"))

species_date_counts <- analysis_species_dates %>%
  count(Species_ID, name = "n_dates")

analysis_species_dates <- analysis_species_dates %>%
  left_join(species_date_counts, by = "Species_ID") %>%
  filter(n_dates >= min_valid_dates_per_species)

write_csv(
  analysis_species_dates,
  file.path(out_dir, "BlockA_analysis_species_dates.csv")
)

############################################################
# 5) BLOCK A1 — DATE-LEVEL TPF DATA
#
# Same TPF definition as the primary model, but without averaging to one row per species.
############################################################

protein_flagged <- protein_final %>%
  mutate(
    is_transporter = !is.na(KEGG_Subcategory) &
      str_detect(KEGG_Subcategory, "\\bTransporters\\b"),
    abund = Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm
  )

species_date_tpf <- protein_flagged %>%
  semi_join(
    analysis_species_dates %>% dplyr::select(Species_ID, Date),
    by = c("Species_ID", "Date")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species_ID, Date) %>%
  summarise(
    abund_total = sum(abund, na.rm = TRUE),
    abund_trans = sum(abund[is_transporter], na.rm = TRUE),
    TPF = abund_trans / abund_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    analysis_species_dates %>%
      dplyr::select(Species_ID, Date, TrophicIndex, Group_For_Plots, TrophicGroupPlot, Phylum, Class, N_prot_detected, n_dates),
    by = c("Species_ID", "Date")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(TPF),
    abund_total > 0,
    TPF > 0,
    TPF < 1,
    is.finite(TrophicIndex),
    is.finite(N_prot_detected),
    N_prot_detected > 0,
    !is.na(TrophicGroupPlot),
    !is.na(Phylum),
    !is.na(Class)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TrophicIndex_z       = scale_z(TrophicIndex),
    n_dates_z            = scale_z(n_dates),
    log_prot_detected_z  = scale_z(log1p(N_prot_detected)),
    Species_ID           = factor(Species_ID),
    Phylum               = factor(Phylum)
  )

write_csv(
  species_date_tpf,
  file.path(out_dir, "BlockA_date_level_TPF_data.csv")
)

############################################################
# 6) BLOCK A2 — TRANSITION-LEVEL TRANSPORTER BRAY-CURTIS DATA
#
# EXACTLY aligned to the primary BC workflow:
#   - transporter-only KEGG profiles
#   - consecutive dates only
#   - consecutive means adjacent in the filtered retained date sequence
############################################################

kegg_sd_trans <- protein_final %>%
  semi_join(
    analysis_species_dates %>% dplyr::select(Species_ID, Date),
    by = c("Species_ID", "Date")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(KEGG_ID),
    !is.na(KEGG_Subcategory),
    str_detect(KEGG_Subcategory, "\\bTransporters\\b")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species_ID, Date, KEGG_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    kegg_abund = sum(Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(kegg_abund), kegg_abund > 0)

compute_species_transitions_bc <- function(sp_id, keep_tbl, kegg_tbl) {

  dates_tbl <- keep_tbl %>%
    filter(Species_ID == sp_id) %>%
    arrange(Date)

  dates <- dates_tbl$Date
  if (length(dates) < 2) return(NULL)

  mat_wide <- kegg_tbl %>%
    filter(Species_ID == sp_id, Date %in% dates) %>%
    mutate(Date_chr = as.character(Date)) %>%
    select(Date_chr, KEGG_ID, kegg_abund) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = KEGG_ID,
      values_from = kegg_abund,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    arrange(Date_chr)

  if (nrow(mat_wide) < 2 || ncol(mat_wide) < 2) return(NULL)

  present_dates_chr <- mat_wide$Date_chr
  present_dates <- as.Date(present_dates_chr)

  M_abs <- as.matrix(mat_wide %>% select(-Date_chr))
  rownames(M_abs) <- present_dates_chr

  # Consecutive retained dates only
  pair_tbl <- tibble(
    Date1 = present_dates[-length(present_dates)],
    Date2 = present_dates[-1]
  )

  out <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(pair_tbl)), function(i) {
    d1 <- as.character(pair_tbl$Date1[i])
    d2 <- as.character(pair_tbl$Date2[i])

    bc_abs <- as.numeric(
      vegan::vegdist(
        M_abs[c(d1, d2), , drop = FALSE],
        method = "bray"
      )
    )

    nd1 <- keep_tbl %>%
      filter(Species_ID == sp_id, Date == as.Date(d1)) %>%
      pull(N_prot_detected)

    nd2 <- keep_tbl %>%
      filter(Species_ID == sp_id, Date == as.Date(d2)) %>%
      pull(N_prot_detected)

    tibble(
      Species_ID  = sp_id,
      Date1       = as.Date(d1),
      Date2       = as.Date(d2),
      bc_abs      = bc_abs,
      N_prot_pair = mean(c(nd1, nd2), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })

  bind_rows(out)
}

all_species <- sort(unique(analysis_species_dates$Species_ID))

transitions <- bind_rows(lapply(
  all_species,
  compute_species_transitions_bc,
  keep_tbl = analysis_species_dates,
  kegg_tbl = kegg_sd_trans
)) %>%
  left_join(
    analysis_species_dates %>%
      distinct(Species_ID, TrophicIndex, Group_For_Plots, TrophicGroupPlot, Phylum, Class),
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(bc_abs),
    is.finite(N_prot_pair),
    !is.na(TrophicGroupPlot),
    !is.na(Phylum),
    !is.na(Class)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_bc_abs_logit = logit_bounded(bc_abs, eps = eps),
    TrophicIndex_z    = scale_z(TrophicIndex),
    log_prot_pair_z   = scale_z(log1p(N_prot_pair)),
    Species_ID        = factor(Species_ID),
    Phylum            = factor(Phylum)
  )

write_csv(
  transitions,
  file.path(out_dir, "BlockA_transition_level_BrayCurtis_data.csv")
)

############################################################
# 7) FIT NON-AGGREGATED PRIMARY-ALIGNED MODELS
############################################################
# Primary model logic is preserved, but Species_ID is added as
# a random intercept because Block A uses repeated observations.

m_tpf_blockA <- glmmTMB(
  TPF ~ TrophicIndex_z + n_dates_z + log_prot_detected_z +
    (1 | Phylum) + (1 | Species_ID),
  family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
  data = species_date_tpf
)

m_bc_blockA <- glmmTMB(
  mean_bc_abs_logit ~ TrophicIndex_z + log_prot_pair_z +
    (1 | Phylum) + (1 | Species_ID),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = transitions
)

############################################################
# 8) BUILD MODEL-IMPLIED PREDICTIONS
############################################################

pred_tpf <- tibble(
  TrophicIndex = seq(
    min(species_date_tpf$TrophicIndex, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(species_date_tpf$TrophicIndex, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 300
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    TrophicIndex_z      = (TrophicIndex - mean(species_date_tpf$TrophicIndex, na.rm = TRUE)) /
                          sd(species_date_tpf$TrophicIndex, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_dates_z           = 0,
    log_prot_detected_z = 0,
    Phylum              = factor(levels(species_date_tpf$Phylum)[1], levels = levels(species_date_tpf$Phylum)),
    Species_ID          = factor(levels(species_date_tpf$Species_ID)[1], levels = levels(species_date_tpf$Species_ID))
  )

pred_tpf$fit <- predict(
  m_tpf_blockA,
  newdata = pred_tpf,
  type = "response",
  re.form = NA
)

pred_bc <- tibble(
  TrophicIndex = seq(
    min(transitions$TrophicIndex, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(transitions$TrophicIndex, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 300
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    TrophicIndex_z  = (TrophicIndex - mean(transitions$TrophicIndex, na.rm = TRUE)) /
                      sd(transitions$TrophicIndex, na.rm = TRUE),
    log_prot_pair_z = 0,
    Phylum          = factor(levels(transitions$Phylum)[1], levels = levels(transitions$Phylum)),
    Species_ID      = factor(levels(transitions$Species_ID)[1], levels = levels(transitions$Species_ID))
  )

pred_bc$fit_logit <- predict(
  m_bc_blockA,
  newdata = pred_bc,
  type = "response",
  re.form = NA
)

pred_bc <- pred_bc %>%
  mutate(
    fit_bc_raw = inv_logit(fit_logit)
  )

write_csv(pred_tpf, file.path(out_dir, "BlockA_pred_tpf.csv"))
write_csv(pred_bc,  file.path(out_dir, "BlockA_pred_bc.csv"))

############################################################
# 9) EXTRACT MODEL SUMMARY STATISTICS
############################################################

fix_tpf <- extract_fixed_effect(m_tpf_blockA, "TrophicIndex_z")
fix_bc  <- extract_fixed_effect(m_bc_blockA,  "TrophicIndex_z")

r2_tpf <- r2_nakagawa(m_tpf_blockA)
r2_bc  <- r2_nakagawa(m_bc_blockA)

model_table_raw <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    Response         = "Date-level TPF",
    Level            = "Species × date",
    Family           = "Beta (logit)",
    `Fixed effects`  = "Trophic index + n dates + species-date protein recovery",
    `Random effects` = "(1 | Phylum) + (1 | Species_ID)",
    N                = nrow(species_date_tpf),
    `TI estimate`    = fix_tpf$estimate,
    `TI SE`          = fix_tpf$std_error,
    `TI p`           = fix_tpf$p_value,
    `Marginal R2`    = safe_numeric(r2_tpf$R2_marginal),
    `Conditional R2` = safe_numeric(r2_tpf$R2_conditional)
  ),
  tibble(
    Response         = "Transition-level transporter Bray-Curtis",
    Level            = "Species × consecutive-date pair",
    Family           = "Gaussian on logit scale",
    `Fixed effects`  = "Trophic index + paired species protein recovery",
    `Random effects` = "(1 | Phylum) + (1 | Species_ID)",
    N                = nrow(transitions),
    `TI estimate`    = fix_bc$estimate,
    `TI SE`          = fix_bc$std_error,
    `TI p`           = fix_bc$p_value,
    `Marginal R2`    = safe_numeric(r2_bc$R2_marginal),
    `Conditional R2` = safe_numeric(r2_bc$R2_conditional)
  )
)

write.csv(
  model_table_raw,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "BlockA_nonaggregated_model_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

############################################################
# 10) FIGURE PANEL A — DATE-LEVEL TPF
############################################################

p_a <- ggplot(
  species_date_tpf,
  aes(x = TrophicIndex, y = TPF, fill = TrophicGroupPlot)
) +
  geom_point(
    shape = 21,
    colour = "black",
    size = 1.7,
    stroke = 0.2,
    alpha = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = pred_tpf,
    aes(x = TrophicIndex, y = fit),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1.0,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_rug(
    aes(x = TrophicIndex),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    data = species_date_tpf,
    sides = "b",
    alpha = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = trophic_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Non-aggregated TPF",
    subtitle = paste0("Species × date beta-model fit (n = ", nrow(species_date_tpf), ")"),
    x = "Trophic index",
    y = "Transporter proteome fraction"
  ) +
  theme_nat()

############################################################
# 11) FIGURE PANEL B — TRANSITION-LEVEL BRAY-CURTIS
############################################################

p_b <- ggplot(
  transitions,
  aes(x = TrophicIndex, y = bc_abs, fill = TrophicGroupPlot)
) +
  geom_point(
    shape = 21,
    colour = "black",
    size = 1.7,
    stroke = 0.2,
    alpha = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = pred_bc,
    aes(x = TrophicIndex, y = fit_bc_raw),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1.0,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_rug(
    aes(x = TrophicIndex),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    data = transitions,
    sides = "b",
    alpha = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = trophic_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Non-aggregated Bray-Curtis dissimilarity",
    subtitle = paste0("Species × consecutive-date pair Gaussian-model fit (n = ", nrow(transitions), ")"),
    x = "Trophic index",
    y = "Transporter Bray-Curtis dissimilarity"
  ) +
  theme_nat()

blockA_fig <- (p_a | p_b) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(blockA_fig)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "BlockA_nonaggregated_primary_aligned_models.png"),
  plot = blockA_fig,
  width = 10.5,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = dpi_out,
  bg = "white"
)

############################################################
# SOURCE DATA — SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE 36
############################################################

source_dir <- paste0(
  "C:/SynologyDrive/PhD/Projects/SpringBloom2021/",
  "DataAnalysis_SpringBloom2021/Source_Data_Supplement"
)


# ============================================================
# Panel A — non-aggregated TPF
# Species x date observations + fitted beta-model response
# ============================================================

Suppl_Figure_36a <- bind_rows(

  # Observed species-date values
  species_date_tpf %>%
    transmute(
      Data_Type = "Species-date observation",
      Species_ID = as.character(Species_ID),
      Date,
      Trophic_Index = TrophicIndex,
      Trophic_Group = as.character(TrophicGroupPlot),
      TPF,
      Proteins_Detected = N_prot_detected,
      Number_of_Retained_Dates = n_dates,
      Model_Fit = NA_real_
    ),

  # Population-level fitted response
  pred_tpf %>%
    transmute(
      Data_Type = "Model fit",
      Species_ID = NA_character_,
      Date = as.Date(NA),
      Trophic_Index = TrophicIndex,
      Trophic_Group = NA_character_,
      TPF = NA_real_,
      Proteins_Detected = NA_real_,
      Number_of_Retained_Dates = NA_real_,
      Model_Fit = fit
    )
)

write_csv(
  Suppl_Figure_36a,
  file.path(
    source_dir,
    "Suppl_Figure_36a.csv"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# Panel B — non-aggregated transporter Bray-Curtis
# Species x consecutive-date transition observations
# + fitted Gaussian-model response
# ============================================================

Suppl_Figure_36b <- bind_rows(

  # Observed consecutive-date transitions
  transitions %>%
    transmute(
      Data_Type = "Species-transition observation",
      Species_ID = as.character(Species_ID),
      Date_1 = Date1,

      Mean_Paired_Proteins_Detected = N_prot_pair,
      Model_Fit_Logit = NA_real_,
      Model_Fit_Bray_Curtis = NA_real_
    ),

  # Population-level fitted response
  pred_bc %>%
    transmute(
      Data_Type = "Model fit",
      Species_ID = NA_character_,
      Date_1 = as.Date(NA),
      Date_2 = as.Date(NA),
      Trophic_Index = TrophicIndex,
      Trophic_Group = NA_character_,

      Mean_Paired_Proteins_Detected = NA_real_,
      Model_Fit_Logit = fit_logit,
      Model_Fit_Bray_Curtis = fit_bc_raw
    )
)

write_csv(

    source_dir,
    "Suppl_Figure_36b.csv"
  )
)

############################################################
# 12) DIAGNOSTICS
############################################################

sim_tpf <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m_tpf_blockA, n = 500)
sim_bc  <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m_bc_blockA,  n = 500)

diag_table <- tibble(

############################################################

model_table_portrait <- tibble(

write.csv(

model_table_gt <- model_table_portrait %>%
```

```{r}
####################################################################################################
# BLOCK B — TAXONOMY ROBUSTNESS
#
# PURPOSE
# -------
# Test whether the trophic-index associations with:
#
#   1) mean transporter proteome fraction (TPF), and
#   2) mean transporter Bray–Curtis dissimilarity
#
# remain after accounting for phylum-level taxonomy.
#
# Two complementary model formulations are compared for each response:
#
#   GLOBAL PHYLUM-ADJUSTED MODEL
#     Phylum is included as a random intercept:
#       (1 | Phylum)
#
#   POOLED WITHIN-PHYLUM MODEL
#     Phylum is included as a fixed effect:
#       + Phylum
#
# The pooled model therefore estimates the trophic-index association from
# within-phylum variation while allowing each phylum to have its own intercept.
#
#
# EXPECTED OBJECTS ALREADY IN MEMORY
# ----------------------------------
# protein_final
# retained_species
# retained_species_dates
# species_taxonomy
#
#
# OUTPUT
# ------
# Folder:
#   BlockB_Taxonomy_Robustness/
#
# Files:
#   BlockB_global_and_withinphylum_models.csv
#   BlockB_taxonomy_robustness_summary_table_portrait.csv
#   BlockB_taxonomy_robustness_summary_table_portrait.png
#   BlockB_taxonomy_robustness_summary_table_portrait.html
#
####################################################################################################


suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(vegan)
  library(glmmTMB)
  library(performance)
  library(readr)
  library(gt)
})

set.seed(1)


############################################################
# 1) SETTINGS
############################################################

out_dir <- "BlockB_Taxonomy_Robustness"

dir.create(
  out_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

eps <- 1e-6
min_valid_dates_per_species <- 5


############################################################
# 2) CHECK REQUIRED INPUT OBJECTS AND COLUMNS
############################################################

stopifnot(
  exists("protein_final"),
  exists("retained_species"),
  exists("retained_species_dates"),
  exists("species_taxonomy")
)

required_protein_cols <- c(
  "Species_ID",
  "Protein_ID",
  "Date",
  "Group_For_Plots",
  "TrophicIndex",
  "Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm",
  "KEGG_Subcategory",
  "KEGG_ID"
)

required_species_cols <- c(
  "Species_ID",
  "Group_For_Plots"
)

required_species_date_cols <- c(
  "Species_ID",
  "Date",
  "Group_For_Plots"
)

required_tax_cols <- c(
  "Species_ID",
  "Phylum",
  "Class"
)

stopifnot(
  all(required_protein_cols %in% names(protein_final)),
  all(required_species_cols %in% names(retained_species)),
  all(required_species_date_cols %in% names(retained_species_dates)),
  all(required_tax_cols %in% names(species_taxonomy))
)


############################################################
# 3) BASIC DATA PREPARATION
############################################################

protein_final <- protein_final %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

retained_species_dates <- retained_species_dates %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

species_taxonomy_use <- species_taxonomy %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Species_ID,
    Phylum,
    Class
  ) %>%
  distinct()

species_traits <- protein_final %>%
  distinct(
    Species_ID,
    TrophicIndex,
    Group_For_Plots
  )


############################################################
# 4) HELPER FUNCTIONS
############################################################

# Convert plotting-group names into the three trophic categories.
recode_plot_group <- function(x) {

  out <- case_when(
    x == "Oligo_like"   ~ "Oligotroph",
    x == "Intermediate" ~ "Intermediate",
    x == "Copio_like"   ~ "Copiotroph",
    TRUE                ~ NA_character_
  )

  factor(
    out,
    levels = c(
      "Oligotroph",
      "Intermediate",
      "Copiotroph"
    )
  )
}


# Standardize a numeric variable.
# If there is no variance, return zero rather than generating NaN values.
scale_z <- function(x) {

  s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (!is.finite(s) || s == 0) {
    return(rep(0, length(x)))
  }

  as.numeric(scale(x))
}


# Logit-transform a proportion while preventing exactly 0 or 1.
logit_bounded <- function(x, eps = 1e-6) {

  x <- pmin(
    pmax(x, eps),
    1 - eps
  )

  qlogis(x)
}


# Format numerical values for the final table.
fmt_num_scalar <- function(x, digits = 3) {

  if (
    length(x) == 0 ||
    is.na(x) ||
    !is.finite(x)
  ) {
    return("NA")
  }

  formatC(
    x,
    digits = digits,
    format = "fg",
    flag = "#"
  )
}


# Format p-values for the final table.
fmt_p_scalar <- function(x) {

  if (
    length(x) == 0 ||
    is.na(x) ||
    !is.finite(x)
  ) {
    return("NA")
  }

  if (x < 0.001) {
    return("<0.001")
  }

  formatC(
    x,
    digits = 3,
    format = "fg",
    flag = "#"
  )
}


# Extract estimate, standard error and p-value for one glmmTMB term.
extract_glmmtmb_term <- function(
  model,
  term_name = "TrophicIndex_z"
) {

  sm <- summary(model)$coefficients$cond

  if (!term_name %in% rownames(sm)) {

    return(
      tibble(
        estimate = NA_real_,
        std_error = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  tibble(
    estimate = unname(
      sm[term_name, "Estimate"]
    ),
    std_error = unname(
      sm[term_name, "Std. Error"]
    ),
    p_value = unname(
      sm[term_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    )
  )
}


# Extract marginal and conditional Nakagawa R² from mixed models.
safe_r2_mixed <- function(model) {

  out <- c(
    Marginal_R2 = NA_real_,
    Conditional_R2 = NA_real_
  )

  r2_obj <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      suppressMessages(
        performance::r2_nakagawa(model)
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(r2_obj)) {
    return(out)
  }

  if (!is.null(r2_obj$R2_marginal)) {
    out["Marginal_R2"] <- as.numeric(
      r2_obj$R2_marginal
    )[1]
  }

  if (!is.null(r2_obj$R2_conditional)) {
    out["Conditional_R2"] <- as.numeric(
      r2_obj$R2_conditional
    )[1]
  }

  out
}


# Extract model R² for models containing phylum only as a fixed effect.
#
# This is reported in the table under "Marginal R²".
#
# Conditional R² is not applicable because there is no random-effect
# variance component.
safe_r2_fixed <- function(model) {

  r2_obj <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      suppressMessages(
        performance::r2(model)
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(r2_obj)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  vals <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(r2_obj)
  )

  vals <- vals[
    is.finite(vals)
  ]

  if (length(vals) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  vals[1]
}


############################################################
# 5) SPECIES-LEVEL PROTEIN RECOVERY
#
# Used as a covariate in both analyses.
############################################################

species_date_protein_counts <- protein_final %>%
  semi_join(
    retained_species_dates,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Date"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Species_ID,
    Date
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N_prot_detected = n_distinct(Protein_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


############################################################
# 6) BUILD SPECIES-LEVEL MEAN TPF DATA
#
# Internal model dataset only; not exported.
############################################################

species_date_tpf <- protein_final %>%
  semi_join(
    retained_species_dates,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Date"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    is_transporter =
      !is.na(KEGG_Subcategory) &
      str_detect(
        KEGG_Subcategory,
        "\\bTransporters\\b"
      )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Species_ID,
    Date
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    abund_total = sum(
      Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    abund_trans = sum(
      Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm[is_transporter],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    TPF = abund_trans / abund_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    species_date_protein_counts,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Date"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(TPF),
    abund_total > 0,
    TPF > 0,
    TPF < 1
  )


species_tpf_df <- species_date_tpf %>%
  left_join(
    species_traits,
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    species_taxonomy_use,
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TrophicGroupPlot =
      recode_plot_group(Group_For_Plots)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Species_ID,
    TrophicIndex,
    Group_For_Plots,
    TrophicGroupPlot,
    Phylum,
    Class
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_dates = n(),
    mean_TPF = mean(
      TPF,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_prot_detected = mean(
      N_prot_detected,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_dates >= min_valid_dates_per_species,
    is.finite(TrophicIndex),
    is.finite(mean_TPF),
    mean_TPF > 0,
    mean_TPF < 1,
    is.finite(mean_prot_detected),
    mean_prot_detected > 0,
    !is.na(TrophicGroupPlot),
    !is.na(Phylum),
    !is.na(Class)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TrophicIndex_z =
      scale_z(TrophicIndex),

    n_dates_z =
      scale_z(n_dates),

    log_prot_detected_z =
      scale_z(
        log1p(mean_prot_detected)
      ),

    Phylum = factor(Phylum),
    Class = factor(Class)
  )


############################################################
# 7) BUILD SPECIES-LEVEL TRANSPORTER BRAY–CURTIS DATA
#
# Internal model dataset only; not exported.
############################################################

analysis_species_dates <- retained_species_dates %>%
  semi_join(
    retained_species,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Group_For_Plots"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    species_traits,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Group_For_Plots"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    species_taxonomy_use,
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TrophicGroupPlot =
      recode_plot_group(Group_For_Plots)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    species_date_protein_counts,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Date"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Species_ID,
    Date,
    Group_For_Plots,
    TrophicIndex,
    TrophicGroupPlot,
    Phylum,
    Class,
    N_prot_detected
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(TrophicIndex),
    !is.na(TrophicGroupPlot),
    !is.na(Phylum),
    !is.na(Class)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Species_ID,
    Date
  )


# Transporter abundance per species × date × KEGG ID.
kegg_sd_trans <- protein_final %>%
  semi_join(
    analysis_species_dates %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Species_ID,
        Date
      ),
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Date"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(KEGG_ID),
    !is.na(KEGG_Subcategory),
    str_detect(
      KEGG_Subcategory,
      "\\bTransporters\\b"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Species_ID,
    Date,
    KEGG_ID
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    kegg_abund = sum(
      Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(kegg_abund),
    kegg_abund > 0
  )


# Calculate Bray–Curtis dissimilarity between successive available dates
# for each species.
compute_species_transitions_bc <- function(
  sp_id,
  keep_tbl,
  kegg_tbl
) {

  dates_tbl <- keep_tbl %>%
    filter(
      Species_ID == sp_id
    ) %>%
    arrange(Date)

  dates <- dates_tbl$Date

  if (length(dates) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }


  mat_wide <- kegg_tbl %>%
    filter(
      Species_ID == sp_id,
      Date %in% dates
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Date_chr = as.character(Date)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Date_chr,
      KEGG_ID,
      kegg_abund
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = KEGG_ID,
      values_from = kegg_abund,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    arrange(Date_chr)


  if (
    nrow(mat_wide) < 2 ||
    ncol(mat_wide) < 2
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }


  present_dates <- as.Date(
    mat_wide$Date_chr
  )

  M_abs <- as.matrix(
    mat_wide %>%
      dplyr::select(-Date_chr)
  )

  rownames(M_abs) <- as.character(
    present_dates
  )


  pair_tbl <- tibble(
    Date1 = present_dates[
      -length(present_dates)
    ],
    Date2 = present_dates[-1]
  )


  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      seq_len(nrow(pair_tbl)),
      function(i) {

        d1 <- pair_tbl$Date1[i]
        d2 <- pair_tbl$Date2[i]

        bc_abs <- as.numeric(
          vegan::vegdist(
            M_abs[
              c(
                as.character(d1),
                as.character(d2)
              ),
              ,
              drop = FALSE
            ],
            method = "bray"
          )
        )


        nd1 <- keep_tbl %>%
          filter(
            Species_ID == sp_id,
            Date == d1
          ) %>%
          pull(N_prot_detected)


        nd2 <- keep_tbl %>%
          filter(
            Species_ID == sp_id,
            Date == d2
          ) %>%
          pull(N_prot_detected)


        tibble(
          Species_ID = sp_id,
          Date1 = d1,
          Date2 = d2,
          bc_abs = bc_abs,
          N_prot_pair = mean(
            c(nd1, nd2),
            na.rm = TRUE
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )
}


transitions <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    sort(
      unique(
        analysis_species_dates$Species_ID
      )
    ),
    compute_species_transitions_bc,
    keep_tbl = analysis_species_dates,
    kegg_tbl = kegg_sd_trans
  )
) %>%
  left_join(
    analysis_species_dates %>%
      distinct(
        Species_ID,
        TrophicIndex,
        Group_For_Plots,
        TrophicGroupPlot,
        Phylum,
        Class
      ),
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(bc_abs),
    is.finite(N_prot_pair),
    !is.na(TrophicGroupPlot),
    !is.na(Phylum),
    !is.na(Class)
  )


species_bc_df <- transitions %>%
  group_by(
    Species_ID,
    TrophicIndex,
    Group_For_Plots,
    TrophicGroupPlot,
    Phylum,
    Class
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_transitions = n(),

    mean_bc_abs = mean(
      bc_abs,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_prot_pair = mean(
      N_prot_pair,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(TrophicIndex),
    is.finite(mean_bc_abs),
    mean_bc_abs >= 0,
    mean_bc_abs <= 1,
    is.finite(mean_prot_pair),
    mean_prot_pair > 0,
    !is.na(TrophicGroupPlot),
    !is.na(Phylum),
    !is.na(Class)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_bc_abs_logit =
      logit_bounded(
        mean_bc_abs,
        eps = eps
      ),

    TrophicIndex_z =
      scale_z(TrophicIndex),

    log_prot_pair_z =
      scale_z(
        log1p(mean_prot_pair)
      ),

    Phylum = factor(Phylum),
    Class = factor(Class)
  )


############################################################
# 8) FIT THE FOUR TAXONOMY-ROBUSTNESS MODELS
############################################################

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# TPF: global phylum-adjusted model
# ----------------------------------------------------------

m_tpf_global <- glmmTMB(
  mean_TPF ~
    TrophicIndex_z +
    n_dates_z +
    log_prot_detected_z +
    (1 | Phylum),
  family = beta_family(
    link = "logit"
  ),
  data = species_tpf_df
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# TPF: pooled within-phylum model
# ----------------------------------------------------------

m_tpf_within_pool <- glmmTMB(
  mean_TPF ~
    TrophicIndex_z +
    n_dates_z +
    log_prot_detected_z +
    Phylum,
  family = beta_family(
    link = "logit"
  ),
  data = species_tpf_df
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Bray–Curtis: global phylum-adjusted model
# ----------------------------------------------------------

m_bc_global <- glmmTMB(
  mean_bc_abs_logit ~
    TrophicIndex_z +
    log_prot_pair_z +
    (1 | Phylum),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = species_bc_df
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Bray–Curtis: pooled within-phylum model
# ----------------------------------------------------------

m_bc_within_pool <- glmmTMB(
  mean_bc_abs_logit ~
    TrophicIndex_z +
    log_prot_pair_z +
    Phylum,
  family = gaussian(),
  data = species_bc_df
)


############################################################
# 9) EXTRACT MODEL RESULTS
############################################################

# Helper to turn one fitted model into one row of the
# machine-readable model-summary table.
summarise_taxonomy_model <- function(
  model,
  response,
  model_name,
  taxonomy_test,
  family_label,
  fixed_effects_label,
  random_effects_label,
  n_species,
  mixed_model = FALSE
) {

  trophic_effect <- extract_glmmtmb_term(
    model,
    "TrophicIndex_z"
  )

  if (mixed_model) {

    r2 <- safe_r2_mixed(model)

    marginal_r2 <- unname(
      r2["Marginal_R2"]
    )

    conditional_r2 <- unname(
      r2["Conditional_R2"]
    )

  } else {

    marginal_r2 <-
      safe_r2_fixed(model)

    conditional_r2 <-
      NA_real_
  }


  tibble(
    Response = response,
    Model_name = model_name,
    Taxonomy_test = taxonomy_test,
    Family = family_label,
    Fixed_effects = fixed_effects_label,
    Random_effects = random_effects_label,
    N_species = n_species,
    estimate = trophic_effect$estimate,
    std_error = trophic_effect$std_error,
    p_value = trophic_effect$p_value,
    Marginal_R2 = marginal_r2,
    Conditional_R2 = conditional_r2
  )
}


global_pooled_tbl <- bind_rows(

  summarise_taxonomy_model(
    model = m_tpf_global,
    response = "Mean TPF",
    model_name = "TPF global",
    taxonomy_test = "Global phylum-adjusted model",
    family_label = "Beta (logit)",
    fixed_effects_label = paste(
      "Trophic index + n dates +",
      "mean species protein recovery"
    ),
    random_effects_label = "(1 | Phylum)",
    n_species = nrow(species_tpf_df),
    mixed_model = TRUE
  ),


  summarise_taxonomy_model(
    model = m_tpf_within_pool,
    response = "Mean TPF",
    model_name = "TPF pooled within-phylum",
    taxonomy_test = "Within-phylum pooled model",
    family_label = "Beta (logit)",
    fixed_effects_label = paste(
      "Trophic index + n dates +",
      "mean species protein recovery + Phylum"
    ),
    random_effects_label = "None",
    n_species = nrow(species_tpf_df),
    mixed_model = FALSE
  ),


  summarise_taxonomy_model(
    model = m_bc_global,
    response = "Mean transporter Bray-Curtis",
    model_name = "Bray-Curtis global",
    taxonomy_test = "Global phylum-adjusted model",
    family_label = "Gaussian on logit scale",
    fixed_effects_label = paste(
      "Trophic index + mean species protein recovery",
      "(paired consecutive dates)"
    ),
    random_effects_label = "(1 | Phylum)",
    n_species = nrow(species_bc_df),
    mixed_model = TRUE
  ),


  summarise_taxonomy_model(
    model = m_bc_within_pool,
    response = "Mean transporter Bray-Curtis",
    model_name = "Bray-Curtis pooled within-phylum",
    taxonomy_test = "Within-phylum pooled model",
    family_label = "Gaussian on logit scale",
    fixed_effects_label = paste(
      "Trophic index + mean species protein recovery",
      "(paired consecutive dates) + Phylum"
    ),
    random_effects_label = "None",
    n_species = nrow(species_bc_df),
    mixed_model = FALSE
  )
)


# Machine-readable source table underlying the formatted summary.
write_csv(
  global_pooled_tbl,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "BlockB_global_and_withinphylum_models.csv"
  )
)


############################################################
# 10) CONVERT MODEL RESULTS TO PORTRAIT TABLE FORMAT
############################################################

model_order <- c(
  "TPF global",
  "TPF pooled within-phylum",
  "Bray-Curtis global",
  "Bray-Curtis pooled within-phylum"
)

metric_order <- c(
  "Response",
  "Family",
  "Fixed effects",
  "Random effects",
  "N",
  "Trophic-index estimate",
  "Trophic-index SE",
  "Trophic-index p",
  "Marginal R²",
  "Conditional R²"
)


# Format all values exactly as they should appear in the final table.
table_source <- global_pooled_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    Model_name = factor(
      Model_name,
      levels = model_order
    ),

    Response = as.character(Response),
    Family = as.character(Family),
    `Fixed effects` = as.character(Fixed_effects),
    `Random effects` = as.character(Random_effects),

    N = as.character(N_species),

    `Trophic-index estimate` = vapply(
      estimate,
      fmt_num_scalar,
      character(1),
      digits = 3
    ),

    `Trophic-index SE` = vapply(
      std_error,
      fmt_num_scalar,
      character(1),
      digits = 3
    ),

    `Trophic-index p` = vapply(
      p_value,
      fmt_p_scalar,
      character(1)
    ),

    `Marginal R²` = vapply(
      Marginal_R2,
      fmt_num_scalar,
      character(1),
      digits = 3
    ),

    `Conditional R²` = vapply(
      Conditional_R2,
      fmt_num_scalar,
      character(1),
      digits = 3
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Model_name,
    Response,
    Family,
    `Fixed effects`,
    `Random effects`,
    N,
    `Trophic-index estimate`,
    `Trophic-index SE`,
    `Trophic-index p`,
    `Marginal R²`,
    `Conditional R²`
  )


# Turn the one-row-per-model representation into the
# portrait orientation used in the supplementary table.
table_rows <- table_source %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Model_name,
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = metric_order
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Metric,
    Model_name
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Model_name,
    values_from = Value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = as.character(Metric)
  )


# Export exactly the values displayed in the final table.
write_csv(
  table_rows,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "BlockB_taxonomy_robustness_summary_table_portrait.csv"
  )
)


############################################################
# 11) FORMAT FINAL SUPPLEMENTARY TABLE
############################################################

summary_table_gt <- table_rows %>%

  gt() %>%

  tab_header(
    title = md(
      "**Taxonomy robustness of trophic-index associations**"
    ),
    subtitle = paste(
      "Global phylum-adjusted and pooled",
      "within-phylum model summaries"
    )
  ) %>%

  cols_label(
    Metric = "",

    `TPF global` =
      "TPF (global)",

    `TPF pooled within-phylum` =
      "TPF (pooled within-phylum)",

    `Bray-Curtis global` =
      "Bray–Curtis (global)",

    `Bray-Curtis pooled within-phylum` =
      "Bray–Curtis (pooled within-phylum)"
  ) %>%

  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = Metric
  ) %>%

  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(
      `TPF global`,
      `TPF pooled within-phylum`,
      `Bray-Curtis global`,
      `Bray-Curtis pooled within-phylum`
    )
  ) %>%

  cols_width(
    Metric ~ px(240),
    `TPF global` ~ px(235),
    `TPF pooled within-phylum` ~ px(260),
    `Bray-Curtis global` ~ px(235),
    `Bray-Curtis pooled within-phylum` ~ px(270)
  ) %>%

  opt_row_striping() %>%

  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(10),
    data_row.padding = px(5),
    column_labels.font.size = px(10),
    heading.title.font.size = px(13),
    heading.subtitle.font.size = px(10)
  ) %>%

  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md(
      paste(
        "Global phylum-adjusted models estimate the",
        "trophic-index effect after accounting for phylum",
        "as a random intercept. Pooled within-phylum models",
        "instead include phylum as a fixed effect, so the",
        "trophic-index slope is estimated from within-phylum",
        "structure. For the pooled models, conditional R² is",
        "not applicable because no random-effect variance",
        "component is modeled."
      )
    )
  )


############################################################
# 12) DISPLAY AND EXPORT FINAL TABLE
############################################################

print(summary_table_gt)


gtsave(
  summary_table_gt,
  filename = file.path(
    out_dir,
    "BlockB_taxonomy_robustness_summary_table_portrait.png"
  ),
  vwidth = 1700,
  vheight = 1200,
  zoom = 4
)


gtsave(
  summary_table_gt,
  filename = file.path(
    out_dir,
    "BlockB_taxonomy_robustness_summary_table_portrait.html"
  )
)


############################################################
# 13) CONSOLE SUMMARY
############################################################

cat("\n")
cat("Block B taxonomy-robustness analysis complete.\n")
cat("Outputs written to:\n")
cat(out_dir, "\n\n")

cat("Files created:\n")

cat(
  "-",
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "BlockB_global_and_withinphylum_models.csv"
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "-",
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "BlockB_taxonomy_robustness_summary_table_portrait.csv"
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "-",
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "BlockB_taxonomy_robustness_summary_table_portrait.png"
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "-",
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "BlockB_taxonomy_robustness_summary_table_portrait.html"
  ),
  "\n"
)
```
