```{r}
####################################################################################################
#  FUNCTIONAL SPECIFICITY ANALYSIS
#
# PURPOSE
# -------
# Test whether trophic-index effects on temporal variability are concentrated in
# resource-acquisition functions rather than reflecting a general property of species abundance,
# total proteome structure, or other broad proteome categories.
#
# ------------
# - keeps the same analysis backbone
# - EXCLUDES the separate transporter-only model from the final summary table
# - renders the summary table in PORTRAIT format:
#       columns = analysis spaces
#       rows    = model parameters / interpretation fields
# - explicitly reports:
#       * response
#       * model family
#       * fixed effects
#       * random effects
#       * N species
#       * trophic-index estimate / CI / p
#       * exp(beta)
#       * marginal and conditional R²
#       * TI10 -> TI90 response change
#
#
# OUTPUT
# ------
# Folder:
#   BlockC_Unified_FunctionalSpecificity/
####################################################################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(vegan)
  library(glmmTMB)
  library(broom)
  library(broom.mixed)
  library(performance)
  library(patchwork)
  library(gt)
  library(grid)
})

set.seed(1)

####################################################################################################
# 0) SETTINGS
####################################################################################################

abundance_col <- "Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm"

min_proteins_per_date_global <- 10
min_valid_dates_per_species_global <- 5

min_features_per_date_analysis <- 1
min_valid_dates_per_species_analysis <- 5

transporter_regex <- "\\bTransporters\\b"
eps <- 1e-6

# Full analysis order for model fitting / figures
analysis_order <- c(
  "Species abundance",
  "Total proteome",
  "Growth machinery",
  "Core metabolism/biosynthesis",
  "Resource acquisition",
  "Transporters"
)

# Table order excludes transporters
table_analysis_order <- c(
  "Species abundance",
  "Total proteome",
  "Growth machinery",
  "Core metabolism/biosynthesis",
  "Resource acquisition"
)

trophic_levels <- c("Oligo_like", "Intermediate", "Copio_like")
trophic_cols <- c(
  "Oligo_like"   = "#93C2E6",
  "Intermediate" = "#EDEAE9",
  "Copio_like"   = "#BA5205"
)

outdir <- "BlockC_Unified_FunctionalSpecificity"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

####################################################################################################
# 1) BASIC CHECKS
####################################################################################################

stopifnot(
  exists("protein_final"),
  exists("retained_species"),
  exists("retained_species_dates"),
  exists("species_taxonomy"),
  exists("species_abundance")
)

stopifnot(
  all(c("Species_ID", "Date", "Protein_ID", "Group_For_Plots", "TrophicIndex") %in% names(protein_final)),
  all(c("Species_ID", "Date", "Group_For_Plots") %in% names(retained_species_dates)),
  all(c("Species_ID") %in% names(retained_species)),
  all(c("Species_ID", "Phylum") %in% names(species_taxonomy)),
  all(c("Species_ID", "Date", "Species_Abundance") %in% names(species_abundance))
)

protein_final <- protein_final %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

retained_species_dates <- retained_species_dates %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

species_abundance <- species_abundance %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

####################################################################################################
# 2) HELPERS
####################################################################################################

fmt_p_scalar <- function(p) {
  if (length(p) == 0 || is.na(p) || !is.finite(p)) return("NA")
  if (p < 1e-4) return("<1e-4")
  if (p < 1e-3) return("<0.001")
  formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)
}

fmt_num_scalar <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || !is.finite(x)) return("NA")
  formatC(x, digits = digits, format = "f")
}

fmt_p <- function(x) vapply(x, fmt_p_scalar, character(1))
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) vapply(x, fmt_num_scalar, character(1), digits = digits)

logit01 <- function(x, eps = 1e-6) {
  x2 <- pmin(pmax(x, eps), 1 - eps)
  qlogis(x2)
}

safe_scale <- function(x) {
  s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(s) || s == 0) {
    rep(0, length(x))
  } else {
    as.numeric(scale(x))
  }
}

theme_nature_clean <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )
}

safe_r2_vals <- function(model) {
  out <- c(Marginal_R2 = NA_real_, Conditional_R2 = NA_real_)

  r2_obj <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(performance::r2_nakagawa(model))),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(r2_obj)) return(out)

  if (is.atomic(r2_obj) && !is.null(names(r2_obj))) {
    if ("R2_marginal" %in% names(r2_obj)) {
      out["Marginal_R2"] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(r2_obj["R2_marginal"])[1])
    }
    if ("R2_conditional" %in% names(r2_obj)) {
      out["Conditional_R2"] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(r2_obj["R2_conditional"])[1])
    }
  }

  if (!is.atomic(r2_obj)) {
    if (!is.null(r2_obj$R2_marginal)) {
      out["Marginal_R2"] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(r2_obj$R2_marginal)[1])
    }
    if (!is.null(r2_obj$R2_conditional)) {
      out["Conditional_R2"] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(r2_obj$R2_conditional)[1])
    }
  }

  out
}

####################################################################################################
# 3) EXPLICIT FUNCTIONAL CATEGORY LABELS
####################################################################################################

growth_labels <- c(
  "Ribosome",
  "Ribosome biogenesis",
  "Translation factors",
  "Transfer RNA biogenesis",
  "Messenger RNA biogenesis",
  "Chaperones and folding catalysts",
  "Exosome",
  "Proteasome",
  "Ubiquitin system",
  "Mitochondrial biogenesis"
)

resource_labels <- c(
  "Secretion system",
  "Two-component system",
  "Membrane trafficking",
  "Ion channels",
  "Lectins"
)

core_labels <- c(
  "Enzymes",
  "Amino acid related enzymes",
  "Lipid biosynthesis proteins",
  "Lipopolysaccharide biosynthesis proteins",
  "Glycosyltransferases",
  "Polyketide biosynthesis proteins",
  "Prenyltransferases",
  "Cytochrome P450",
  "Peptidoglycan biosynthesis and degradation proteins",
  "Photosynthesis proteins"
)

####################################################################################################
# 4) RECONSTRUCT SHARED RETAINED UNIVERSE
####################################################################################################

retained_keys <- retained_species_dates %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, Date, Group_For_Plots)

protein_final_u <- protein_final %>%
  semi_join(retained_keys, by = c("Species_ID", "Date", "Group_For_Plots")) %>%
  semi_join(retained_species %>% distinct(Species_ID), by = "Species_ID")

species_abundance_u <- species_abundance %>%
  semi_join(retained_species_dates %>% distinct(Species_ID, Date), by = c("Species_ID", "Date")) %>%
  semi_join(retained_species %>% distinct(Species_ID), by = "Species_ID")

species_meta <- protein_final_u %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, TrophicIndex, TrophicGroup, Group_For_Plots) %>%
  mutate(
    TrophicGroup = case_when(
      Group_For_Plots %in% trophic_levels ~ Group_For_Plots,
      TrophicGroup %in% trophic_levels ~ TrophicGroup,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(
    species_taxonomy %>%
      distinct(Species_ID, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species),
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(TrophicIndex),
    !is.na(TrophicGroup),
    !is.na(Phylum),
    !is.na(Class)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TrophicGroup = factor(TrophicGroup, levels = trophic_levels),
    Phylum = factor(Phylum),
    Class = factor(Class)
  )

####################################################################################################
# 5) GLOBAL QC
####################################################################################################

species_date_qc <- protein_final_u %>%
  mutate(
    is_transporter = !is.na(KEGG_Subcategory) & str_detect(KEGG_Subcategory, transporter_regex)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species_ID, Date) %>%
  summarise(
    N_prot_detected = n_distinct(Protein_ID),
    has_transporter = any(is_transporter, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_nontrans = any(!is_transporter, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    N_prot_detected >= min_proteins_per_date_global,
    has_transporter,
    has_nontrans
  )

species_keep_global <- species_date_qc %>%
  count(Species_ID, name = "n_dates_global") %>%
  filter(n_dates_global >= min_valid_dates_per_species_global)

species_date_keep_global <- species_date_qc %>%
  semi_join(species_keep_global, by = "Species_ID") %>%
  inner_join(species_meta, by = "Species_ID") %>%
  mutate(Species_ID = factor(Species_ID))

cat("\n=== Shared global QC universe ===\n")
cat("QC-passed species×dates:", nrow(species_date_keep_global), "\n")
cat("QC-passed species:", dplyr::n_distinct(species_date_keep_global$Species_ID), "\n")

####################################################################################################
# 6) FULL DATA PREPARATION
####################################################################################################

protein_base <- protein_final_u %>%
  inner_join(
    species_date_keep_global %>% dplyr::select(Species_ID, Date),
    by = c("Species_ID", "Date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    KEGG_ID = if_else(is.na(KEGG_ID) | KEGG_ID == "", NA_character_, KEGG_ID),
    is_transporter = !is.na(KEGG_Subcategory) & str_detect(KEGG_Subcategory, transporter_regex)
  ) %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, Date, Protein_ID, KEGG_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number())

protein_labels_long <- protein_base %>%
  transmute(
    row_id,
    Species_ID,
    Date,
    Protein_ID,
    KEGG_ID,
    is_transporter,
    KEGG_Subcategory = if_else(
      is.na(KEGG_Subcategory) | trimws(KEGG_Subcategory) == "",
      "Unannotated",
      KEGG_Subcategory
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    KEGG_Subcategory = str_replace_all(KEGG_Subcategory, "\\s*;\\s*", ";")
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(KEGG_Subcategory, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(
    Label = trimws(KEGG_Subcategory),
    Label = if_else(is.na(Label) | Label == "", "Unannotated", Label)
  )

protein_category_flags <- protein_labels_long %>%
  group_by(row_id) %>%
  summarise(
    is_growth = any(Label %in% growth_labels, na.rm = TRUE),
    is_core = any(Label %in% core_labels, na.rm = TRUE),
    is_resource_nontrans = any(Label %in% resource_labels, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

protein_processed <- protein_base %>%
  left_join(protein_category_flags, by = "row_id") %>%
  mutate(
    is_growth = if_else(is.na(is_growth), FALSE, is_growth),
    is_core = if_else(is.na(is_core), FALSE, is_core),
    is_resource_nontrans = if_else(is.na(is_resource_nontrans), FALSE, is_resource_nontrans),
    is_resource_any = is_transporter | is_resource_nontrans,
    n_split_categories = as.integer(is_growth) +
      as.integer(is_core) +
      as.integer(is_resource_any),
    w_growth = if_else(is_growth & n_split_categories > 0, 1 / n_split_categories, 0),
    w_core = if_else(is_core & n_split_categories > 0, 1 / n_split_categories, 0),
    w_resource = if_else(is_resource_any & n_split_categories > 0, 1 / n_split_categories, 0),
    w_transporters = if_else(is_transporter, 1, 0)
  )

####################################################################################################
# 7) BUILD ANALYSIS-READY FEATURE TABLES
####################################################################################################

build_feature_table <- function(mode) {

  if (mode == "species_abundance") {
    return(
      species_abundance_u %>%
        inner_join(
          species_date_keep_global %>% dplyr::select(Species_ID, Date),
          by = c("Species_ID", "Date")
        ) %>%
        filter(is.finite(Species_Abundance), Species_Abundance > 0) %>%
        transmute(
          Species_ID,
          Date,
          Feature_ID = "Species_Abundance",
          abundance = Species_Abundance
        )
    )
  }

  if (mode == "total_proteome") {
    return(
      protein_processed %>%
        filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID)) %>%
        group_by(Species_ID, Date, KEGG_ID) %>%
        summarise(
          abundance = sum(.data[[abundance_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        filter(is.finite(abundance), abundance > 0) %>%
        rename(Feature_ID = KEGG_ID)
    )
  }

  if (mode == "growth_machinery") {
    return(
      protein_processed %>%
        filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID), w_growth > 0) %>%
        group_by(Species_ID, Date, KEGG_ID) %>%
        summarise(
          abundance = sum(.data[[abundance_col]] * w_growth, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        filter(is.finite(abundance), abundance > 0) %>%
        rename(Feature_ID = KEGG_ID)
    )
  }

  if (mode == "core_metabolism") {
    return(
      protein_processed %>%
        filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID), w_core > 0) %>%
        group_by(Species_ID, Date, KEGG_ID) %>%
        summarise(
          abundance = sum(.data[[abundance_col]] * w_core, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        filter(is.finite(abundance), abundance > 0) %>%
        rename(Feature_ID = KEGG_ID)
    )
  }

  if (mode == "resource_acquisition") {
    return(
      protein_processed %>%
        filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID), w_resource > 0) %>%
        group_by(Species_ID, Date, KEGG_ID) %>%
        summarise(
          abundance = sum(.data[[abundance_col]] * w_resource, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        filter(is.finite(abundance), abundance > 0) %>%
        rename(Feature_ID = KEGG_ID)
    )
  }

  if (mode == "transporters") {
    return(
      protein_processed %>%
        filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID), w_transporters > 0) %>%
        group_by(Species_ID, Date, KEGG_ID) %>%
        summarise(
          abundance = sum(.data[[abundance_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        filter(is.finite(abundance), abundance > 0) %>%
        rename(Feature_ID = KEGG_ID)
    )
  }

  stop("Unknown mode: ", mode)
}

####################################################################################################
# 8) BUILD ANALYSIS-SPECIFIC KEEP TABLE
####################################################################################################

build_analysis_keep_tbl <- function(feature_tbl, analysis_label) {

  date_feature_counts <- feature_tbl %>%
    group_by(Species_ID, Date) %>%
    summarise(
      n_features = n_distinct(Feature_ID),
      total_abund = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      n_features >= min_features_per_date_analysis,
      is.finite(total_abund),
      total_abund > 0
    )

  keep_tbl <- species_date_keep_global %>%
    inner_join(date_feature_counts, by = c("Species_ID", "Date")) %>%
    group_by(Species_ID) %>%
    mutate(n_dates_analysis = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(n_dates_analysis >= min_valid_dates_per_species_analysis) %>%
    mutate(
      Analysis = analysis_label,
      Species_ID = factor(Species_ID),
      TrophicGroup = factor(TrophicGroup, levels = trophic_levels),
      Phylum = factor(Phylum)
    )

  keep_tbl
}

####################################################################################################
# 9) COMPUTE CONSECUTIVE-DATE BRAY–CURTIS DISSIMILARITY
####################################################################################################

compute_transitions_bc <- function(feature_tbl, keep_tbl, analysis_label) {

  valid_species <- keep_tbl %>%
    distinct(Species_ID) %>%
    pull(Species_ID) %>%
    as.character()

  out <- lapply(valid_species, function(sp_id_chr) {

    dates <- keep_tbl %>%
      filter(as.character(Species_ID) == sp_id_chr) %>%
      distinct(Date) %>%
      arrange(Date) %>%
      pull(Date)

    if (length(dates) < 2) return(NULL)

    mat_wide <- feature_tbl %>%
      filter(as.character(Species_ID) == sp_id_chr, Date %in% dates) %>%
      mutate(Date = as.character(Date)) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = Feature_ID,
        values_from = abundance,
        values_fill = 0
      ) %>%
      arrange(match(Date, as.character(dates)))

    M <- as.matrix(mat_wide %>% dplyr::select(-Species_ID, -Date))
    rownames(M) <- mat_wide$Date

    if (nrow(M) < 2) return(NULL)

    pairs <- tibble(
      Date1 = dates[-length(dates)],
      Date2 = dates[-1]
    )

    bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) {
      d1 <- as.character(pairs$Date1[i])
      d2 <- as.character(pairs$Date2[i])

      bc <- as.numeric(vegdist(M[c(d1, d2), , drop = FALSE], method = "bray"))

      nd1 <- keep_tbl %>%
        filter(as.character(Species_ID) == sp_id_chr, Date == pairs$Date1[i]) %>%
        pull(N_prot_detected)

      nd2 <- keep_tbl %>%
        filter(as.character(Species_ID) == sp_id_chr, Date == pairs$Date2[i]) %>%
        pull(N_prot_detected)

      nf1 <- keep_tbl %>%
        filter(as.character(Species_ID) == sp_id_chr, Date == pairs$Date1[i]) %>%
        pull(n_features)

      nf2 <- keep_tbl %>%
        filter(as.character(Species_ID) == sp_id_chr, Date == pairs$Date2[i]) %>%
        pull(n_features)

      tibble(
        Analysis = analysis_label,
        Species_ID = sp_id_chr,
        Date1 = pairs$Date1[i],
        Date2 = pairs$Date2[i],
        BrayCurtis = bc,
        N_prot_pair = mean(c(nd1, nd2), na.rm = TRUE),
        N_feat_pair = mean(c(nf1, nf2), na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    }))
  })

  bind_rows(out) %>%
    left_join(
      keep_tbl %>%
        mutate(Species_ID_chr = as.character(Species_ID)) %>%
        distinct(Species_ID_chr, TrophicIndex, TrophicGroup, Phylum),
      by = c("Species_ID" = "Species_ID_chr")
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(BrayCurtis), is.finite(TrophicIndex)) %>%
    mutate(
      BC_logit = logit01(BrayCurtis, eps = eps),
      log_prot_pair = log1p(N_prot_pair),
      log_feat_pair = log1p(N_feat_pair),
      TrophicIndex_z = safe_scale(TrophicIndex),
      log_prot_pair_z = safe_scale(log_prot_pair),
      log_feat_pair_z = safe_scale(log_feat_pair),
      TrophicGroup = factor(TrophicGroup, levels = trophic_levels),
      Species_ID = factor(Species_ID),
      Phylum = factor(Phylum)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Species_ID),
      !is.na(Phylum),
      is.finite(BC_logit),
      is.finite(TrophicIndex_z)
    ) %>%
    droplevels()
}

####################################################################################################
# 10) SUMMARISE TO SPECIES-LEVEL VARIABILITY
####################################################################################################

summarise_species_variability <- function(transitions_tbl) {
  transitions_tbl %>%
    group_by(Analysis, Species_ID, TrophicIndex, TrophicGroup, Phylum) %>%
    summarise(
      n_transitions = n(),
      mean_bc = mean(BrayCurtis, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_bc = median(BrayCurtis, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_N_prot_pair = mean(N_prot_pair, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_N_feat_pair = mean(N_feat_pair, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      mean_bc_logit = logit01(mean_bc, eps = eps),
      median_bc_logit = logit01(median_bc, eps = eps),
      log_prot_pair = log1p(mean_N_prot_pair),
      log_feat_pair = log1p(mean_N_feat_pair),
      TrophicIndex_z = safe_scale(TrophicIndex),
      n_transitions_z = safe_scale(n_transitions),
      log_prot_pair_z = safe_scale(log_prot_pair),
      log_feat_pair_z = safe_scale(log_feat_pair),
      TrophicGroup = factor(TrophicGroup, levels = trophic_levels),
      Phylum = factor(Phylum)
    )
}

####################################################################################################
# 11) SPECIES-LEVEL MODEL FITTER
####################################################################################################

fit_species_model_safe <- function(df, response_col = "mean_bc_logit") {

  model_df <- df %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data[[response_col]]),
      is.finite(TrophicIndex_z),
      is.finite(n_transitions_z),
      is.finite(log_prot_pair_z),
      !is.na(Phylum)
    ) %>%
    mutate(Phylum = factor(Phylum)) %>%
    droplevels()

  if (nrow(model_df) < 8) {
    stop("Too few rows to fit model.")
  }

  rhs <- "TrophicIndex_z + n_transitions_z + log_prot_pair_z"

  if (nlevels(model_df$Phylum) >= 2) {
    mixed_formula <- as.formula(
      paste(response_col, "~", rhs, "+ (1 | Phylum)")
    )

    mixed_try <- tryCatch(
      glmmTMB(
        formula = mixed_formula,
        family = gaussian(),
        data = model_df
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(mixed_try)) {
      return(list(
        model = mixed_try,
        model_class = "glmmTMB",
        data_used = model_df,
        response_col = response_col,
        fixed_effects_text = "Trophic index + n transitions + mean species protein recovery (paired consecutive dates)",
        random_effects_text = "(1 | Phylum)",
        family_text = "Gaussian on logit scale"
      ))
    }
  }

  lm_formula <- if (nlevels(model_df$Phylum) >= 2) {
    as.formula(paste(response_col, "~", rhs, "+ Phylum"))
  } else {
    as.formula(paste(response_col, "~", rhs))
  }

  lm_fit <- lm(lm_formula, data = model_df)

  list(
    model = lm_fit,
    model_class = "lm",
    data_used = model_df,
    response_col = response_col,
    fixed_effects_text = "Trophic index + n transitions + mean species protein recovery (paired consecutive dates) + Phylum",
    random_effects_text = "None (linear-model fallback)",
    family_text = "Gaussian on logit scale"
  )
}

####################################################################################################
# 12) EXTRACT MODEL STATS
####################################################################################################

extract_species_model_stats <- function(model_obj, analysis_label) {

  model <- model_obj$model
  model_class <- model_obj$model_class
  df <- model_obj$data_used

  if (model_class == "glmmTMB") {
    td <- broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE)
    ti <- td %>% filter(term == "TrophicIndex_z")
    r2_vals <- safe_r2_vals(model)
    r2m <- unname(r2_vals["Marginal_R2"])
    r2c <- unname(r2_vals["Conditional_R2"])
  } else {
    td <- broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE)
    ti <- td %>% filter(term == "TrophicIndex_z")
    r2m <- summary(model)$r.squared
    r2c <- summary(model)$r.squared
  }

  ti10 <- as.numeric(quantile(df$TrophicIndex, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE))
  ti90 <- as.numeric(quantile(df$TrophicIndex, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE))
  mu_ti <- mean(df$TrophicIndex, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_ti <- sd(df$TrophicIndex, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(sd_ti) || sd_ti == 0) sd_ti <- 1

  nd <- tibble(
    TrophicIndex_z = c((ti10 - mu_ti) / sd_ti, (ti90 - mu_ti) / sd_ti),
    n_transitions_z = 0,
    log_prot_pair_z = 0
  )

  if ("Phylum" %in% names(df)) {
    nd$Phylum <- factor(rep(levels(df$Phylum)[1], 2), levels = levels(df$Phylum))
  }

  if (model_class == "glmmTMB") {
    pred <- predict(model, newdata = nd, type = "link", re.form = NA)
  } else {
    pred <- predict(model, newdata = nd)
  }

  pred_resp <- plogis(pred)

  tibble(
    Analysis = analysis_label,
    response = "Mean Bray–Curtis dissimilarity",
    model_class = model_class,
    family_text = model_obj$family_text,
    fixed_effects_text = model_obj$fixed_effects_text,
    random_effects_text = model_obj$random_effects_text,
    beta = ti$estimate[1],
    conf.low = ti$conf.low[1],
    conf.high = ti$conf.high[1],
    p_value = ti$p.value[1],
    exp_beta = exp(ti$estimate[1]),
    exp_low = exp(ti$conf.low[1]),
    exp_high = exp(ti$conf.high[1]),
    R2_marginal = r2m[1],
    R2_conditional = r2c[1],
    TI10 = ti10,
    TI90 = ti90,
    pred_TI10 = pred_resp[1],
    pred_TI90 = pred_resp[2],
    delta = pred_resp[2] - pred_resp[1],
    ratio = pred_resp[2] / pred_resp[1],
    N_species = dplyr::n_distinct(df$Species_ID),
    N_rows = nrow(df),
    label = paste0(
      "β=", fmt_num_scalar(ti$estimate[1], 3),
      " [", fmt_num_scalar(ti$conf.low[1], 3), ", ", fmt_num_scalar(ti$conf.high[1], 3), "]\n",
      "p=", fmt_p_scalar(ti$p.value[1]),
      "; exp(β)=", fmt_num_scalar(exp(ti$estimate[1]), 2), "\n",
      "R²m=", fmt_num_scalar(r2m[1], 2),
      "; R²c=", fmt_num_scalar(r2c[1], 2), "\n",
      "Δ(TI10→TI90)=", fmt_num_scalar(pred_resp[2] - pred_resp[1], 3),
      "; ratio=", fmt_num_scalar(pred_resp[2] / pred_resp[1], 2), "\n",
      "N species=", dplyr::n_distinct(df$Species_ID)
    )
  )
}

####################################################################################################
# 13) PREDICTION CURVES
####################################################################################################

get_species_prediction_curve <- function(model_obj, analysis_label) {

  model <- model_obj$model
  model_class <- model_obj$model_class
  df <- model_obj$data_used

  mu_ti <- mean(df$TrophicIndex, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_ti <- sd(df$TrophicIndex, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(sd_ti) || sd_ti == 0) sd_ti <- 1

  ti_seq <- seq(min(df$TrophicIndex, na.rm = TRUE), max(df$TrophicIndex, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 200)

  nd <- tibble(
    TrophicIndex_z = (ti_seq - mu_ti) / sd_ti,
    n_transitions_z = 0,
    log_prot_pair_z = 0
  )

  if ("Phylum" %in% names(df)) {
    nd$Phylum <- factor(rep(levels(df$Phylum)[1], nrow(nd)), levels = levels(df$Phylum))
  }

  if (model_class == "glmmTMB") {
    pred <- predict(model, newdata = nd, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE, re.form = NA)

    out <- nd %>%
      mutate(
        TrophicIndex = ti_seq,
        fit = pred$fit,
        se = pred$se.fit,
        conf.low = fit - 1.96 * se,
        conf.high = fit + 1.96 * se,
        predicted = plogis(fit),
        pred_low = plogis(conf.low),
        pred_high = plogis(conf.high),
        Analysis = analysis_label
      )
  } else {
    pred <- predict(model, newdata = nd, se.fit = TRUE)

    out <- nd %>%
      mutate(
        TrophicIndex = ti_seq,
        fit = pred$fit,
        se = pred$se.fit,
        conf.low = fit - 1.96 * se,
        conf.high = fit + 1.96 * se,
        predicted = plogis(fit),
        pred_low = plogis(conf.low),
        pred_high = plogis(conf.high),
        Analysis = analysis_label
      )
  }

  out
}

####################################################################################################
# 14) ANALYSIS SPECIFICATIONS
####################################################################################################

analysis_specs <- tribble(
  ~Analysis,                       ~mode,
  "Species abundance",            "species_abundance",
  "Total proteome",               "total_proteome",
  "Growth machinery",             "growth_machinery",
  "Core metabolism/biosynthesis", "core_metabolism",
  "Resource acquisition",         "resource_acquisition",
  "Transporters",                 "transporters"
)

####################################################################################################
# 15) RUN ALL ANALYSES
####################################################################################################

feature_tables <- list()
keep_tables <- list()
transition_tables <- list()
species_tables <- list()
mean_model_objs <- list()
mean_model_stats_list <- list()
mean_prediction_list <- list()
included_species_list <- list()
excluded_species_list <- list()

global_species_set <- sort(as.character(unique(species_date_keep_global$Species_ID)))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(analysis_specs))) {

  analysis_label <- analysis_specs$Analysis[i]
  mode_i <- analysis_specs$mode[i]

  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("Running:", analysis_label, "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")

  ft <- build_feature_table(mode_i)
  feature_tables[[analysis_label]] <- ft

  keep_tbl <- build_analysis_keep_tbl(ft, analysis_label)
  keep_tables[[analysis_label]] <- keep_tbl

  included_species_list[[analysis_label]] <- tibble(
    Analysis = analysis_label,
    Species_ID = sort(as.character(unique(keep_tbl$Species_ID)))
  )

  excluded_species_list[[analysis_label]] <- tibble(
    Analysis = analysis_label,
    Species_ID = setdiff(global_species_set, sort(as.character(unique(keep_tbl$Species_ID))))
  )

  cat("QC-passed species:", dplyr::n_distinct(keep_tbl$Species_ID), "\n")
  cat("QC-passed species×dates:", nrow(keep_tbl), "\n")

  if (dplyr::n_distinct(keep_tbl$Species_ID) < 5) {
    warning("Too few species after analysis-specific QC for: ", analysis_label)
    next
  }

  trans_tbl <- compute_transitions_bc(ft, keep_tbl, analysis_label)
  transition_tables[[analysis_label]] <- trans_tbl

  if (nrow(trans_tbl) == 0) {
    warning("No transitions available for: ", analysis_label)
    next
  }

  species_tbl <- summarise_species_variability(trans_tbl)
  species_tables[[analysis_label]] <- species_tbl

  mean_model_obj <- fit_species_model_safe(species_tbl, response_col = "mean_bc_logit")
  mean_model_objs[[analysis_label]] <- mean_model_obj

  mean_model_stats_list[[analysis_label]] <- extract_species_model_stats(mean_model_obj, analysis_label)
  mean_prediction_list[[analysis_label]] <- get_species_prediction_curve(mean_model_obj, analysis_label)
}

####################################################################################################
# 16) COMBINE OUTPUT TABLES
####################################################################################################

transition_results <- bind_rows(transition_tables)
species_results <- bind_rows(species_tables)
mean_model_stats_df <- bind_rows(mean_model_stats_list)
mean_prediction_df <- bind_rows(mean_prediction_list)
included_species_df <- bind_rows(included_species_list)
excluded_species_df <- bind_rows(excluded_species_list)

transition_results <- transition_results %>%
  mutate(Analysis = factor(Analysis, levels = analysis_order))

species_results <- species_results %>%
  mutate(Analysis = factor(Analysis, levels = analysis_order))

mean_prediction_df <- mean_prediction_df %>%
  mutate(Analysis = factor(Analysis, levels = analysis_order))

mean_model_stats_df <- mean_model_stats_df %>%
  mutate(Analysis = factor(Analysis, levels = analysis_order))

####################################################################################################
# 17) FIGURE 1 — COEFFICIENT COMPARISON ACROSS ANALYSIS SPACES
####################################################################################################

coef_plot_df <- mean_model_stats_df %>%
  mutate(
    Analysis = factor(Analysis, levels = rev(analysis_order))
  )

p_coef <- ggplot(coef_plot_df, aes(x = beta, y = Analysis)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high),
    height = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Functional specificity of trophic-index effects on temporal variability",
    subtitle = "Species-level mean Bray–Curtis dissimilarity models across six analysis spaces",
    x = "Trophic-index coefficient",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_nature_clean()

print(p_coef)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "Final_FunctionalSpecificity_coefficients.png"),
  plot = p_coef,
  width = 9.5,
  height = 5.8,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

####################################################################################################
# 18) FIGURE 2 — MULTI-ROW FITTED RESPONSE PANELS
####################################################################################################

make_row_plot <- function(analysis_label) {

  dat <- species_results %>%
    filter(Analysis == analysis_label) %>%
    droplevels()

  pred <- mean_prediction_df %>%
    filter(Analysis == analysis_label)

  mod_stats <- mean_model_stats_df %>%
    filter(Analysis == analysis_label)

  label_df <- tibble(
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = mod_stats$label[1]
  )

  ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = dat,
      aes(x = TrophicIndex, y = mean_bc, fill = TrophicGroup),
      shape = 21,
      color = "grey25",
      stroke = 0.2,
      size = 2.0,
      alpha = 0.80
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = pred,
      aes(x = TrophicIndex, ymin = pred_low, ymax = pred_high),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.18,
      fill = "grey55"
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = pred,
      aes(x = TrophicIndex, y = predicted),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.95,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_label(
      data = label_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 1.02,
      vjust = 1.02,
      size = 2.9,
      linewidth = 0.25,
      fill = "white",
      label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines")
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.02), clip = "off") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = trophic_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = analysis_label,
      x = "Trophic index",
      y = "Mean consecutive-date Bray–Curtis dissimilarity"
    ) +
    theme_nature_clean() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 18, 5.5, 5.5)
    )
}

row_plots <- lapply(analysis_order, make_row_plot)

fit_figure <- wrap_plots(row_plots, ncol = 1) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Fitted trophic-index responses across abundance, whole-proteome, and functional spaces",
    subtitle = "Species-level mean Bray–Curtis dissimilarity"
  )

print(fit_figure)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "Final_FunctionalSpecificity_fitted_panels.png"),
  plot = fit_figure,
  width = 8.8,
  height = 18.0,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

####################################################################################################
# 19) SUMMARY TABLE — PORTRAIT FORMAT, COLUMNS = ANALYSIS SPACES
#     EXCLUDES TRANSPORTERS
####################################################################################################

summary_table_source <- mean_model_stats_df %>%
  filter(Analysis %in% table_analysis_order) %>%
  arrange(match(Analysis, table_analysis_order))

summary_table_portrait <- tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Response",
    "Model family",
    "Fixed effects",
    "Random effects",
    "N species",
    "Trophic-index estimate",

  )
)

for (an in table_analysis_order) {
  row_i <- summary_table_source %>% filter(Analysis == an)

  summary_table_portrait[[an]] <- c(
    row_i$response,

    fmt_num_scalar(row_i$beta, 3),
    paste0("[", fmt_num_scalar(row_i$conf.low, 3), ", ", fmt_num_scalar(row_i$conf.high, 3), "]"),
    fmt_p_scalar(row_i$p_value),
    fmt_num_scalar(row_i$exp_beta, 2),
    fmt_num_scalar(row_i$R2_marginal, 3),
    fmt_num_scalar(row_i$R2_conditional, 3),
    fmt_num_scalar(row_i$delta, 3),
    fmt_num_scalar(row_i$ratio, 2)
  )
}

write_csv(
  summary_table_portrait,
  file.path(outdir, "Final_FunctionalSpecificity_summary_table_portrait.csv")
)

summary_table_gt <- summary_table_portrait %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Functional specificity of trophic-index effects on temporal variability**"),
    subtitle = "Species abundance, total proteome, growth machinery, core metabolism / biosynthesis, and resource acquisition"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Metric = "",
    `Species abundance` = "Species abundance",
    `Total proteome` = "Total proteome",

  cols_width(

Species abundance is included as a temporal reference baseline. Proteome-based feature spaces were constructed from iBAQ-normalized abundances summed per KEGG ortholog. Growth machinery, core metabolism / biosynthesis, and resource acquisition were defined from explicit KEGG subcategory labels."
    )

print(summary_table_gt)

gtsave(

gtsave(

)

####################################################################################################
# 20) WRITE CORE OUTPUT TABLES
####################################################################################################

write_csv(transition_results, file.path(outdir, "Final_transition_level_results.csv"))
write_csv(species_results, file.path(outdir, "Final_species_level_results.csv"))
```
